question: A _____ satellite GSAT-12 was launched by PSLV-C17 from Sriharikota.
solution:
The correct answer is __**communication.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **GSAT-12**

 
 
• **​**GSAT-12 is a **communication satellite** designed and developed by the** Indian Space Research Organisation.**
 
• It is the second satellite to be launched and placed on a GTO using PSLV.
 
• It was launched onboard **PSLV-XL C-17 **from the second launch pad of Satish Dhawan Space Centre on** July 15, 2011.**
 
• It is considered to be a replacement of the aged satellite** INSAT-3B.**
 
• It will provide services like tele-education, telemedicine, disaster management support and satellite internet access.
 
• The tentative life of a satellite is **8 years.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PSLV**

 
 
• **​**The **Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) **is an expendable medium-lift launch vehicle designed.
 
• It is operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It was developed to allow India to launch its Indian Remote Sensing (IRS) satellites into sun-synchronous orbits.
 
• PSLV can also launch small-size satellites into **Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO).**
